title: Omega swarm wave manifest
description: Coordinator-written pre-assignment of board items to Devin Cloud sessions. tools/swarm/launch.py validates this shape by hand; this schema documents it and serves as a test fixture.

wave.description: Wave identifier used in titles, tags, and build/swarm/<wave>/ output.

max_acu_limit.description: Per-session ACU cap passed as max_acu_limit.

devin_mode.description: Only per-session knob; the model cannot be chosen; null means the org default mode. Omitted from the request when null.

owner_label_prefix.description: Landing owner label prefix; sessions land as <prefix>-<session name>.

exclusions.description: Board item or session names the wave must not take (in-flight human work).

item.description: Board item name; must appear as **<item>.** in the board file.

host.description: Cloud VMs are Linux x86-64 only.

owning_paths.description: Repository-relative paths this session owns; no two sessions may share one.

suggested_first_slice.description: Optional hint rendered as a suggestion; the board item's acceptance governs.

host_gates.description: Commands the landing slice's acceptance depends on; each must exit 0 on the coordinator host or the slot is not landable from a Linux session.

probe_only.description: The slot is exploratory; verification_only is an accepted planned outcome and failing host_gates are recorded instead of rejecting the manifest.
